title: 第1427章 新坠入三千维度的宫阙群第1426章 被吊起来的超脱者从容离开
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
第1427章新坠入三千维度的宫阙群
“终于回来了。”
“这一趟绝灭之地本来很顺畅，没想到归来却碰上一名敌对超脱者。”
李越坐在永恒天宫之中，感叹道。
这一战他损失不小。
‘灭绝婉儿’送给他的超脱级至宝中，攻伐秘术被用掉，只剩下防御和逃命的两道秘术了。
两颗乾源一气雷珠耗尽。
虎魄傀儡仅有三击半步超脱级之力，也被用去两击。
他右手一翻。
取出那两团璀璨宝光。
这是超脱级至宝彻底泯灭后留下的东西。
而且这两件超脱级至宝，不是被生灵打碎，而是被三千维度意志打碎。
“就是不知道这两团宝光，能不能弥补一部分我的损失了……”
“还有半步超脱级陨落的本源，希望能有用一些……”
他叹了口气。
三千维度的历史上，从未出现过半步超脱级陨落后的残留本源。
这或许是第一份。
他将东西再次收起。
随后目光看向大臻帝庭、永恒神庭。
一百一十年过去。

不论是大臻帝庭还是永恒神庭，再一次带给他数量庞大的神力！
无以计数的香火愿力席卷入「神域」，继而转化成精纯至极的神力。
永恒神庭驻地‘三十六天’中，也有大量神力涌入他的「神域」之色。
片刻后。
“一百二十亿界神力！”
“加上我剩余的九十七亿界神力——”
“现在我足足拥有二百一十七亿界神力！”
李越面上露出喜悦之色。
庞大数量的神力，带给了他极强安全感。
甚至——
若是有必要——
他都已经能够开启‘万倍战力’了！
开启‘千倍战力’，需要消耗三千万界神力。
开启‘三千倍战力’，需要消耗两亿界神力。
而开启‘万倍战力’，则需要消耗十五亿界神力！
以他如今的神力储备，完全可以开启十四次‘万倍战力’！
而以他‘乾源永恒身’第二层的强大体魄，也完全能够支撑开启‘万倍战力’暴涨的实力！
“以我如今实力——”
“若是开启‘万倍战力’——”
content_en:
Chapter 1427 Newly falling into the palace complex of three thousand dimensions
"Finally back."
"This trip to the Land of Extinction was originally smooth, but I didn't expect to encounter a hostile transcendent when I returned."
Li Yue sighed while sitting in the Eternal Heavenly Palace.
He suffered a lot in this battle.
Among the transcendental treasures given to him by 'Mie Mie Wan'er', the secret techniques of attack have been used, leaving only the two secret techniques of defense and escape.
The two Qiyuan Thunder Beads were exhausted.
The Tiger Soul Puppet only had three strikes and half a step of transcendence power, but it was also used for two strikes.
He flipped his right hand.
Take out the two groups of bright treasures.
This is what is left after the transcendent level treasure is completely destroyed.
Moreover, these two transcendent treasures were not broken by living beings, but by the will of three thousand dimensions.
"I just don't know if these two groups of precious lights can make up for part of my losses..."
"There is still the origin of the half-step transcendental fall. I hope it can be of some use..."
He sighed.
In the history of the Three Thousand Dimensions, there has never been a remnant of the origin after the fall of the Half-Step Transcendence Level.
This may be the first one.
He put the things away again.
Then he looked at the Dazhen Emperor Court and the Eternal Divine Court.
One hundred and ten years have passed.
Whether it was the Great Emperor's Court or the Eternal Divine Court, they once again brought him a huge amount of divine power!
Countless incense and wishing power swept into the "god realm", and then transformed into extremely pure divine power.
In the "Thirty-Six Heavens" where the Eternal Divine Court resides, a large amount of divine power also pours into his "divine domain".
After a while.
"Twelve billion realms of divine power!"
"With the addition of my remaining 9.7 billion world divine power——"
"Now I have 21.7 billion divine powers!"
Li Yue's face showed joy.
The huge amount of divine power gave him a strong sense of security.
Even——
If necessary——
He has already been able to activate the ‘Ten Thousand Times Combat Power’!
To activate the 'Thousand Times Combat Power', 30 million world divine powers are required.
To activate the 'Three Thousand Times Combat Power', it takes 200 million divine power.
And to activate the ‘Ten Thousand Times Combat Power’, it will require consuming 1.5 billion world divine power!
With his current reserve of divine power, he can fully activate the 'Ten Thousand Times Combat Power' fourteen times!
And with his powerful physique at the second level of his ‘Qianyuan Eternal Body’, he is fully able to support the surge in strength when he activates his ‘Ten Thousand Times Combat Power’!
"With my current strength——"
"If the 'Ten Thousand Times Combat Power' is activated——"
